study: Matched decoupled weight decay and group-DRO source pilot; existing methods, no novelty claim
optimizer: AdamW, default betas/eps; decoupled weight decay on all parameters. This is not equivalent to official coupled L2 or an exact paper reproduction.
sampler: Per epoch independently permute each of four source-user pools;16 samples per user per batch,75 batches; cyclically repeat shorter pool. Same order for every arm. Within-user present classes originally balanced; no held samples or labels in sampler.
risk: Uniform group mean CE or logq <- log_softmax(logq + .01*detach(group_mean_CE)); no adjustment/BTL, missing group is an error
selection: Primary: earliest minimum independent validation CE over endpoints0..24; fixed dense tail epochs13..24 is secondary only

gate.primary: dro_reg endpoint selected on validation CE

limits: Six source users repeatedly developed, not untouched validation or original8 protocol
18 new trajectories: three identical-capacity arms; original tail reference has different sampling and lower decay, matched comparisons isolate one factor
No test/diagnostic-label tuning, no regularization/eta/seed/window sweeps on failure
Group DRO and regularization are established controls, not original contribution
One fixed10x weight-decay intervention, not proof all regularized DRO succeeds or fails
Primary cannot be swapped to secondary tail after diagnostic scoring
No test-time updates, known user IDs only at training
Author README/full loss.py read; main paper not read
